Every system a brand uses (its commerce platform, loyalty program, ticketing system, or point-of-sale) holds signals that help our agents decide what to say, to whom, and when. Integrations provide the data and context that is the fuel for Attentive’s Agent OS. Today, Attentive builds and maintains most of its integrations ourselves. That model doesn’t scale to the long tail of systems our brands rely on. We’ve rebuilt our integrations platform from the ground up so that any human or agent team can ship integration features in a single day. The first version of this platform will let our internal product teams ship hundreds of integration features in a single quarter. As the Lead Product Manager, Agentic Integrations Platform, you will turn that foundation into an ecosystem. You’ll expand the platform beyond its product team to two new builder personas: Attentive’s customer-facing teams along with external technology partners who want to build on Attentive. Alongside them, AI agents are a first-class builder persona, and you’ll design for humans and agents working together. This role requires a deep understanding of user personas and what technical integration use cases they are trying to unlock and how to leverage AI to improve the process and experience. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Marketing Agent (Cross-Platform)
jobs.description_text: About the Role Attentive is building an industry-defining Marketing Agent: a unified, autonomous system that understands a brand’s business, decides who to message, when, and with what, and then acts. It builds on three years of advances in predictive audiences, personalization, and AI-generated creative, and it’s designed to deliver a step change in performance for thousands of enterprise brands. Brands already trust Attentive with their customer data, and our models know their shoppers deeply. But marketers run their programs across many tools, and they’re asking to put that intelligence to work everywhere they reach customers, not only in Attentive. We’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to make that happen. You’ll own the strategy for bringing the Marketing Agent to the marketing platforms brands already use. That means letting the agent decide and act inside those environments: building audiences, choosing the right moment to reach (or not reach) each shopper, recommending products, writing on-brand creative, and sending messages through each platform’s own channels. You’ll figure out the right way to connect, whether through APIs, MCP, or deeper integrations, and how to deliver Attentive-quality results wherever our customers work. This is a new product line with its own SKU. You’ll set the strategy, sequence the bets, and partner closely with a dedicated engineering team and with design, ML, data science, and GTM.
